title: Q-RES-ashby-1952-A3: Nothing the second loop can change (measured 0.273, target >= 0.5)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: ashby-1952 finding A3 is not-met (measured 0.273)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-1952:A3
**Prediction:** step_function_share >= 0.5 within 336 h
**Status:** open

Concern: Nothing the second loop can change. The study: Ashby's preface: "any system which shows adaptation must (1) contain many variables that behave as step-functions". The second loop changes the first loop's parameters; where it can only file a work item, the change waits on another loop.

Mechanisms that should answer it: ULTRASTABILITY-1 (doctrine/ultrastability.json).

Metric: share of essential variables whose second loop can change a parameter of the first loop, target >= 0.5. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
